addictionPotential: 极易成瘾且具有高滥用潜力。
toxicities: 当血液酒精浓度达到 0.4% 时可能因乙醇摄入致死。
summary: 酒精是一种通过 GABAₐ 受体起效的中枢抑制剂，是人类最常见的强精神活性物质之一。使用历史悠久，致醉效应已被充分研究与记录。在世界大多数地区仍属合法。
effectsSummary: Relaxation, disinhibition, sociability, euphoria, impaired judgment and coordination, slurred speech, memory impairment.
dosageRemark: Dosage varies greatly depending on individual tolerance, body weight, and experience. Always pace yourself.
generalRisks: Risk of alcohol poisoning, especially with high-proof spirits. Impaired judgment leads to risky behavior. Long-term use causes liver damage, brain damage, addiction.
longtermRisks: Long-term alcohol use leads to liver cirrhosis, brain damage, dementia, heart disease, pancreatitis, and severe addiction.
saferUse: Do not drink on an empty stomach.
Avoid mixing alcohol with other drugs, especially depressants.
